# CHAYA

An Indian horror game for Android by **mxyan games**. You are trapped in an old wooden house by the restless soul of a
27-year-old wife, Chaya. Find every item of the holy ritual - kalash, diya, coconut, kumkum, kapoor and gangajal - and
perform the pooja at the altar to destroy her forever.

* Engine: Godot 4.6 (GL Compatibility, GDScript)
* Map: generated by `tools/maze.py` + `tools/mazegeo.py` and built in **Blender** by `tools/build_map.py` (Cycles ambient-occlusion bake, glTF export)
* Textures: photographic CC0 PBR scans (Poly Haven / ambientCG), fetched at build time
* Sounds: real recordings (Wikimedia Commons), no AI-generated audio
* Character: Microsoft Rocketbox avatar (MIT), re-shaded in-engine
* Build: GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/chaya.yml`) builds the map, downloads the assets and exports the signed APK to the Releases page.

See `CREDITS.md` on each release for the full list of sources and licences.
